conversation_parts.body: Hi Bryn, I’m Mavren from Merrow Vale Motor — we’re having trouble pulling the latest payments report for our policyholders, and it’s holding up our month-end close.
We’re looking to schedule a review of our claims reserves next Tuesday at 11am if that works for your team.

Thanks for reaching out, Mavren. I’ll check the integrations for your account to see if there’s a sync issue with the reporting module. Could you confirm which policyholder group you’re trying to pull data for?
It’s the commercial fleet group — the one with the updated roles assigned last week. I’ve double-checked the permissions and they look correct.
Got it. I’ll run a diagnostic on the roles and integrations for that group. If it’s a permissions lag, we can force a refresh. I’ll email you an update by end of day.
Appreciate the quick response — and yes, please let me know if you need any documents from our end to help troubleshoot.
You’re welcome — we’ll get this sorted before your reporting deadline. I’ll also flag this with our supplier team to ensure no backend delays.
